SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE VIEW [DW].[ViewTotalCustomerHoldings]
AS WITH non_nulls AS (
	SELECT
		'2023-06-01' AS BusinessDateSK
		,A.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
		,A.CustomerID AS CustomerID
		,A.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
		,A.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
		,A.BankSK AS BankSK
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate, B.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate, B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full, B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
		,COALESCE(A.DepositsOutstandingBalance, B.DepositsOutstandingBalance) AS DepositsOutstandingBalance
		,COALESCE(A.LoansRelationshipExposure, B.LoansRelationshipExposure) AS LoansRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.LoansRelationshipExposureFull, B.LoansRelationshipExposureFull) AS LoansRelationshipExposureFull
		,COALESCE(A.LoansOutstanstandingBalance, B.LoansOutstanstandingBalance) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalance
		,COALESCE(A.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull, B.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
		,COALESCE(A.LoansCreditLimit, B.LoansCreditLimit) AS LoansCreditLimit
		,COALESCE(A.LoansCreditLimitFull, B.LoansCreditLimitFull) AS LoansCreditLimitFull
		,COALESCE(A.CardsCreditLimit, B.CardsCreditLimit) AS CardsCreditLimit
		,COALESCE(A.CardsStatementBalance, B.CardsStatementBalance) AS CardsStatementBalance
		,COALESCE(A.CardsRelationshipExposure, B.CardsRelationshipExposure) AS CardsRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.SecuritiesPortfolio, B.SecuritiesPortfolio) AS SecuritiesPortfolio
		,COALESCE(A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment, B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
		,COALESCE(A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full, B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
		,COALESCE(A.TrustFundValue, B.TrustFundValue) AS TrustFundValue
		,COALESCE(A.TrustFundValue_Full, B.TrustFundValue_Full) AS TrustFundValueFull
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipExposure, B.TotalRelationshipExposure) AS TotalRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipExposureFull, B.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipBalance, B.TotalRelationshipBalance) AS TotalRelationshipBalance
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull, B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
		,CASE
			WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
			WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
			END AS MarketSegment
		,CASE
			WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
			WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
			END AS MarketSegmentFull
		,B.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	FROM DW.FactTotalCustomerHoldings A
	LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalCustomerHoldings B
		ON A.FCBSCIF = B.FCBSCIF
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer C
		ON A.CustomerSK = C.CustomerSK
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= A.TotalRelationshipBalance AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance < DMS.UpperLimit
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON DMSF.LowerLimit <= A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < DMSF.UpperLimit
	WHERE A.FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
    AND B.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT
		'2023-06-01' AS BusinessDateSK
		,A.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
		,A.CustomerID AS CustomerID
		,A.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
		,A.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
		,A.BankSK AS BankSK
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate, B.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate, B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
		,COALESCE(A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full, B.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full) AS AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
		,COALESCE(A.DepositsOutstandingBalance, B.DepositsOutstandingBalance) AS DepositsOutstandingBalance
		,COALESCE(A.LoansRelationshipExposure, B.LoansRelationshipExposure) AS LoansRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.LoansRelationshipExposureFull, B.LoansRelationshipExposureFull) AS LoansRelationshipExposureFull
		,COALESCE(A.LoansOutstanstandingBalance, B.LoansOutstanstandingBalance) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalance
		,COALESCE(A.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull, B.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull) AS LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
		,COALESCE(A.LoansCreditLimit, B.LoansCreditLimit) AS LoansCreditLimit
		,COALESCE(A.LoansCreditLimitFull, B.LoansCreditLimitFull) AS LoansCreditLimitFull
		,COALESCE(A.CardsCreditLimit, B.CardsCreditLimit) AS CardsCreditLimit
		,COALESCE(A.CardsStatementBalance, B.CardsStatementBalance) AS CardsStatementBalance
		,COALESCE(A.CardsRelationshipExposure, B.CardsRelationshipExposure) AS CardsRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.SecuritiesPortfolio, B.SecuritiesPortfolio) AS SecuritiesPortfolio
		,COALESCE(A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment, B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
		,COALESCE(A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full, B.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full) AS TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
		,COALESCE(A.TrustFundValue, B.TrustFundValue) AS TrustFundValue
		,COALESCE(A.TrustFundValue_Full, B.TrustFundValue_Full) AS TrustFundValueFull
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipExposure, B.TotalRelationshipExposure) AS TotalRelationshipExposure
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipExposureFull, B.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipBalance, B.TotalRelationshipBalance) AS TotalRelationshipBalance
		,COALESCE(A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull, B.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
		,CASE
			WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
			WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
			END AS MarketSegment
		,CASE
			WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'    
			WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName
			END AS MarketSegmentFull
		,B.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	FROM DW.FactTotalCustomerHoldings B
	LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalCustomerHoldings A
		ON A.FCBSCIF = B.FCBSCIF
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer C
		ON A.CustomerSK = C.CustomerSK
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS ON DMS.LowerLimit <= A.TotalRelationshipBalance AND A.TotalRelationshipBalance < DMS.UpperLimit
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON DMSF.LowerLimit <= A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AND A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull < DMSF.UpperLimit
	WHERE A.FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
    AND A.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate IS NOT NULL
)
, nulls AS (
SELECT
	'2023-06-01' AS BusinessDateSK
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,GlobalCIF
	,FCBSCIF
	,BankSK
	,AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
	,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
	,AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate_Full
	,DepositsOutstandingBalance
	,LoansRelationshipExposure
	,LoansRelationshipExposureFull
	,LoansOutstanstandingBalance
	,LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
	,LoansCreditLimit
	,LoansCreditLimitFull
	,CardsCreditLimit
	,CardsStatementBalance
	,CardsRelationshipExposure
	,SecuritiesPortfolio
	,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
	,TreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Full
	,TrustFundValue
	,TrustFundValue_Full
	,TotalRelationshipExposure
	,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
	,TotalRelationshipBalance
	,TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
	,MarketSegment
	,MarketSegmentFull
	,SourceSystemCode
 FROM DW.FactTotalCustomerHoldings
 WHERE FCBSCIF IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM non_nulls
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM nulls;
GO
